comparison_method.paper_metrics: Recomputed in float64 from paper true and pred columns.
comparison_method.reproduction_metrics: Recomputed in float32 from test true_RTv and pred_central columns, matching evaluator tensor precision.
comparison_method.test_target_exact_order_match: Equal counts and position-by-position numpy.isclose with rtol=1e-7 and atol=1e-6.
comparison_method.prediction_pearson_correlation: numpy.corrcoef on position-aligned paper pred and reproduction pred_central values parsed from CSV.
